supported_release_wording: For this finite ranked deterministic procurement model, an adaptive observation-based strategy guarantees success across all four listed initial worlds at exact minimum worst-case action cost 8. No open-loop strategy guarantees success in the same model.

interpretation.optimality: The complete certificate checks every relevant alternative and outcome branch. Strategy replay separately establishes a cost-8 achievable upper bound.
interpretation.infeasibility: A null optimal_cost denotes no guaranteed-success strategy in the stated policy class, not zero cost.
interpretation.cost: Cost is the model-declared positive integer action cost, not cash, elapsed time, or tokens.
